name: ai.tetrees/mcp
title: Tetrees MCP
description: Search, acquire, run, grow, checkpoint, verify and publish portable TAIP/1 agent intelligence through Tetrees.

environmentVariables.name: TETREES_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Revocable account API token from Tetrees Account settings

environmentVariables.name: TETREES_CLIENT_EXTENSIONS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to local client-extensions.json (never uploaded)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional BYOK OpenAI key for a selected run; never persisted by Tetrees

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional BYOK Anthropic key for a selected run; never persisted by Tetrees

environmentVariables.name: ZAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional BYOK Z.AI key for a selected run; never persisted by Tetrees
